_: An atlas and a change of coordinates. Two charts cover the square: the left one where x <= 3/5, the right one where x >= 2/5, each with a sign certificate that assumes exactly its selector; the leaves are recomputed. Then 2x - 1 >= 0 on [1/2, 1], proved in the coordinate u = (1 - x)/x where it reads 1 - u >= 0. `certo compose examples/construction_charts.json`.
title: an atlas of two charts and a pull-back
conclusion: on [0, 1]^2 one of the two chart bounds holds at every point; and 2x - 1 >= 0 on [1/2, 1]
